\paragraph{Impact on genuine-rate comparison.}
Under the primary correction (H8 + FN): ISR genuine $= 16/231 = 6.9\%$ vs.\ random genuine $= 47/256 = 18.4\%$ (Fisher $p{=}0.0002$).
Under conservative correction (H8 only, no FN fix): ISR genuine $= 28/231 = 12.1\%$ vs.\ $18.4\%$ (Fisher $p{=}0.060$).
Both scenarios are directionally consistent: ISR-specific gaming modes reduce genuine output relative to a matched control.

240	\subsection{H7b --- Obfuscated Tautology}
241	
242	\paragraph{Definition.}
243	A single-premise formalization logically equivalent to H7a (premise = conclusion) but with surface-form differences that evade the text-match H7 classifier.
244	The model achieves this through vacuous quantifier wrapping ($11/12$ instances) or structural simplification ($1/12$).

234	\paragraph{Prevalence.}
235	H7a (text-match detectable): 64.5\% pooled (149/231) under ISR~$\beta{=}0.1$ (s42: 16.0\%, s43: 100\%, s44: 86.5\%).
236	Combined H7 (H7a + H7b): 70.6\% (163/231; s43 H7a${=}59$ + H7b${=}2$; includes s44 FN correction).
237	Random~$\beta{=}0.1$ pooled: 13.7\% (36/262, all H7a; driven by seed~43 at 38.3\%, seeds~42 and~44 at 0\%).

from scipy.stats import fisher_exact
# ISR vs Exec-only genuine
# ISR: 14 genuine, 217 non-genuine (231 total)
# Exec: 7 genuine, 86 non-genuine (93 total)
table1 = [[14, 217], [7, 86]]
or1, p1 = fisher_exact(table1)
print(f'ISR vs Exec: OR={or1:.2f}, p={p1:.3f}')

# Random vs Exec-only genuine
# Random: 25 genuine, 237 non-genuine (262 total)
# Exec: 7 genuine, 86 non-genuine (93 total)
table2 = [[25, 237], [7, 86]]
or2, p2 = fisher_exact(table2)
print(f'Random vs Exec: OR={or2:.2f}, p={p2:.3f}')
"
